_about: One entry per place the app gets promoted. Run: python scripts/make_channel_links.py — it writes site/go/<slug>/index.html, site/qr/<slug>.png and docs/CHANNEL_LINKS.md. Campaign names (ct) are what App Analytics reports under: 30 characters at most, never reuse one for a different channel.
